decisions.decision_value: Project Manager Betty introduces the project goal to design a new remote control that is original, trendy, and user-friendly.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: This thing we are gonna um uh design is a new remote control. Uh should be original, trendy, and, of course, user friendly.

decisions.decision_value: Project Manager Betty sets the financial parameters: 25 Euro selling price, 50 million Euro profit target, international market, and maximum production cost of 12.50 Euros.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: and the production cost should not exceed hopefully should be less than twelve fifty Euro.

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009a, UI Designer Francina proposes a compact multi-purpose remote control that can control the TV as well as household heating and air-conditioning.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Like uh the remote control which we use for T_V_, it shou uh it should be used f uh for some other purpose also,

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009a, Marketing Expert Eileen and Project Manager Betty propose a locator signal (beep or blinking/fluorescent light) to find the remote when lost.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I think another thing that would help is um if it beeps when you clap, because I think one of the big things that happens

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009b, Project Manager Betty announces instructions from higher management eliminating teletext and restricting the remote to controlling only the TV due to complexity and time-to-market.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: according to to higher management the it should only control the T_V_, mostly because they feel that it's too comp complex a task

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009b, Project Manager Betty relays management's requirement that corporate image, colour, and design must be maintained on the product.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: that the corporate image is being maintained, and that the corporate colour and design are being used on the product,

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009b, Industrial Designer Jeanne-Oui and UI Designer Francina propose adding a display clock and alarm clock to the remote control.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: if you want more features then we can display a clock it I I don't think it will take any money extra money

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009b, the team decides that the target group is everybody who owns a TV, addressing subgroups (children, elderly) through ergonomic shapes and button design if budget permits.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: But I think I I think to sum it up the target group is basically everybody. If money permits we can address some features

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009c, UI Designer Francina proposes speech recognition (an integrated programmable sample sensor speaker unit) as the most important feature for the remote.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Now the most important feature I would like to have in my remote would be the speech recognition feature.

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009c, the team decides to use ordinary push-buttons with a simple chip rather than scroll wheels in order to keep costs low.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: We'll just go for push buttons for in the interest of cost. Okay.

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009c, Industrial Designer Jeanne-Oui warns that a good voice recognition system could be problematic and costly.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: So to get a good recogni recognising system, it's a costly thing, I think.

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009c, the team agrees on using a standard battery, chip on print, and a bright, colourful, compact, strong case with push-buttons.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I think I think battery, and I think we all agreed on that. That that's that's gonna be most cost-effective and the best thing.

decisions.decision_value: At the close of IS1009c, Marketing Expert Eileen and the team tentatively adopt speech recognition as a supplement pending more research from the Industrial Designer on how expensive it is.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Okay, so why don't we put down speech recognition if possible pending some more research from our industrial engineer on how expensive that is.

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009d, Industrial Designer Jeanne-Oui and UI Designer Francina present the final prototype: a blue snail-shaped hard plastic remote with an oyster-shell holder, raised soft-rubber buttons, a flexible swapping button, and an inbuilt voice recogniser.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: This is a model of the remote control which we are going to build. Uh this is us in a snail shape

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009d, during the financing calculation, Marketing Expert Eileen confirms they did not put the clock or LCD display into the final design.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: No, 'cause we didn't put the clock in it after all, right?

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009d, Project Manager Betty calculates the final production cost on the spreadsheet as 8.20 Euros (initially reading 7.60 before adding the final button supplements), well under the 12.50 Euro limit.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: That's hmm? Eight point two, right? So, we looks like we are well within budget.

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009d, Project Manager Betty realizes that the 8.20 Euro financing calculation did NOT include the voice recogniser because she did not see a line item for it on the spreadsheet.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I just realised one thing. In the financing there was no room for our voice recogniser.

decisions.decision_value: In IS1009d, Project Manager Betty and Marketing Expert Eileen note that with the calculated cost at 8.20 Euros and a 12.50 Euro budget cap, they have a maximum of 4.30 Euros remaining to cover the unpriced voice recogniser.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I mean maximum we have another four point three euros I mean four thirty.

decisions.decision_value: At the close of IS1009d, Project Manager Betty reiterates that they cannot add more features because they must leave the remaining 4.30 Euro budget headroom for the voice recogniser.
decisions.semantic_target_quote: we need uh you know we need to leave space money-wise for the voice recogniser.
